start.description:
🛒 Welcome to {system_name} - Automated Account Store 24/7!

✨ Here you can:
• Browse available products
• Place orders quickly
• Pay via QR Code
• Receive products automatically after payment

📌 Use /products to view products
📌 Use /balance to view your wallet
📌 Use /help for instructions
